subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential, scope, consent, and subscription contract should it expose?
rationale: Source review proves the missing capability, but receiving non-mentioned Space content changes data visibility, credential storage, OAuth scopes, admin/user consent, and event-subscription lifecycle boundaries that automation should not choose.

options.title: Approve plugin-local OAuth/events design
options.body: Define a Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events design with SecretRef-backed credentials, explicit scopes, consent/admin approval, Space filtering, setup docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

options.title: Keep mentioned webhooks only
options.body: Leave the official plugin on the current service-account webhook model and handle only separate thread-reply/session cleanup.

options.title: Defer to broader Workspace auth
options.body: Wait for a shared Google Workspace token, consent, event-subscription, and admin-approval model before accepting a channel-specific expansion.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-local OAuth/events design
recommendation.body: Define a Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events design with SecretRef-backed credentials, explicit scopes, consent/admin approval, Space filtering, setup docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined routing signal from Google Chat API/docs/threading history and prior review context on this security-sensitive channel boundary.
